sentences.zh: 你不会觉得你经历的这些事情——你以为只有你自己在经历，但当你看了这些演出，你会觉得，哇，

sentences.en: this is happening to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 原来很多人都在经历这些。

sentences.en: You said, you know, to reach certain levels of comedy, you got to be offensive.
sentences.zh: 你说过，你知道，要达到某种喜剧层次，你就得具有冒犯性。

sentences.en: And there is the material in the special.
sentences.zh: 而特辑里确实有这样的素材。

sentences.en: I'm thinking in particular of the, like the Magic Johnson AIDS material.
sentences.zh: 我特别想到的是，比如魔术师约翰逊的艾滋病相关素材。

sentences.en: Oh, you saw the special.
sentences.zh: 哦，你看过这特辑。

sentences.en: I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我看过。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Which, by the way, he has HIV, not AIDS.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他得的是HIV，不是艾滋病。

sentences.en: You should go in and re-dub that.
sentences.zh: 你应该去把那段重新配音。

sentences.en: You know what the other mistake you make is?
sentences.zh: 你知道你犯的另一个错误是什么吗？

sentences.en: You call Louis Armstrong, sax player, trumpet player.
sentences.zh: 你把路易斯·阿姆斯特朗叫成萨克斯乐手，他其实是小号手。

sentences.en: But it was still funny, right?
sentences.zh: 但这还是挺搞笑的，对吧？

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键是这样的。

sentences.en: You can't be super, like, on point with the facts.
sentences.zh: 你不可能对事实做到百分之百精准。

sentences.en: When you're telling jokes, sometimes you just, you tell the jokes, man.
sentences.zh: 当你讲笑话时，有时你就是——你只管讲笑话，伙计。

sentences.en: And what's crazy is, like, I've had friends and relatives to die from AIDS.
sentences.zh: 而疯狂的是，我有朋友和亲戚死于艾滋病。

sentences.en: And so part of even that joke is finding humor and things that happen.
sentences.zh: 所以甚至那个笑话的一部分，也是在发生的事情中寻找幽默。

sentences.en: It's a different way to look at something tragic.
sentences.zh: 这是看待悲剧的一种不同方式。

sentences.en: And I think the world has forgot how to laugh.
sentences.zh: 我觉得世界已经忘记了怎么笑。

sentences.en: And part of it is we're grooming people to be sensitive.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是我们把人们培养得过于敏感。

sentences.en: But I find when I'm in a comedy club, people like to laugh.
sentences.zh: 但我发现当我在喜剧俱乐部时，人们其实很喜欢笑。

sentences.en: They like to laugh at those dark things, the magic jokes.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢对那些黑暗的事情、对魔术的笑话开怀大笑。

sentences.en: People want to laugh again.
sentences.zh: 人们想要再次开怀大笑。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to deprogram and, like, get us back to just laughing.
sentences.zh: 而我正试图进行逆向编程，让我们回到纯粹的笑声中去。

sentences.en: So in the special, you know, there's one magic joke I'm thinking about in particular, where I understand what you're saying, that, you know, you sort of have this series of jokes
sentences.zh: 所以在特辑里，你知道，我特别想起了一个魔术的笑话，我理解你的意思，就是说，你有一系列这样的笑话，

sentences.en: where you're framing it like magic's life got better after he got sick, you know?
sentences.zh: 你把它构建成魔术师生病后生活反而变好了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: That's kind of the hypothesis of the jokes.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是这些笑话的假设前提。

sentences.en: But then, you know, you, like, throw in a line about there about, like, sex with monkeys or whatever.
sentences.zh: 但然后，你知道，你在里面随口抛出了一句台词，比如关于和猴子发生性关系之类的话。

sentences.en: And that was the one really where, like, I cringed.
sentences.zh: 而那正是真正让我感到尴尬的地方。

sentences.en: I was like, oof, that's rough.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，噢，这可真够粗鲁的。

sentences.en: Well, I said, show me the monkey I got next.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我说的是，把我要对付的猴子带上来。

sentences.en: I didn't say he had sex with monkeys.
sentences.zh: 我没说他和猴子发生性关系。

sentences.en: I said, I don't know how he got this good version of this disease.
sentences.zh: 我说的是，我不知道他是怎么得这种改良版的病的。

sentences.en: But however he got that, I want that, I want it that way.
sentences.zh: 但不管他是怎么得的，我也想要，我就要那样。

sentences.en: To me, that was escapism.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那是逃避现实。

sentences.en: Because it's not real.
sentences.zh: 因为这不是真的。

sentences.en: Of course he didn't have sex with a monkey.
sentences.zh: 他当然没有和猴子发生性关系。

sentences.en: If you read into every joke, if you get literal, everybody's going to be offended by it.
sentences.zh: 如果你过度解读每一个笑话，如果你非要较真，每个人都会被它冒犯到。

sentences.en: There's about, I'll play 72 things in that special to be offended by.
sentences.zh: 在这个特辑里大概有——我会抛出72个让人觉得被冒犯的点。

sentences.en: I think great humor is take whoever you send up, those people are laughing the loudeSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为伟大的幽默是，无论你取笑谁，那些人往往笑得最大声。

sentences.en: And I hope that Magic laughs the loudest at that joke.
sentences.zh: 我希望魔术师对这个笑话笑得最大声。

sentences.en: Which he will.
sentences.zh: 他会的。

sentences.en: Magic has a great sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 魔术师有着极好的幽默感。

sentences.en: I hope Shaq laughs at his joke.
sentences.zh: 我希望奥尼尔对他的笑话笑出来。

sentences.en: I hope all of them laugh.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们所有人都能笑。

sentences.en: Do your Shaq impression right now.
sentences.zh: 现在就来一个奥尼尔的模仿。

sentences.en: Do your Shaq impression.
sentences.zh: 来一个你的奥尼尔模仿。

sentences.en: You know, these are friends of mine, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些都是我的朋友，对吧？

sentences.en: When Kevin Hart does a LeBron hairline joke, I don't think LeBron gets mad.
sentences.zh: 当凯文·哈特开勒布朗发际线的玩笑时，我不觉得勒布朗会生气。

sentences.en: I think, you know, part of it is, it's all out there, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，部分原因在于，这些都是公开的，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm not telling no secrets.
sentences.zh: 我又没泄露什么秘密。

sentences.en: This is all out there.
sentences.zh: 这些都是公开的。

sentences.en: I'm just going, here's a different way to look at it.
sentences.zh: 我只是在说，这里有另一种看待它的方式。

sentences.en: I rescued myself from depression by learning to laugh in my worst circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我通过在最糟糕的环境中学会笑，把自己从抑郁中拯救了出来。

sentences.en: Losing my parents broke me.
sentences.zh: 失去父母击垮了我。

sentences.en: And I'm telling the audience, here's how you can survive this.
sentences.zh: 而我在告诉观众，这就是你如何挺过这一切的方法。

sentences.en: Find humor in everything.
sentences.zh: 在一切事物中寻找幽默。

sentences.en: You know, the idea of the culture getting too sensitive or overly sensitive, it's something that people have been talking about and have identified for a while now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，文化变得过于敏感或极其敏感这种观点，是人们一直在谈论并已经识别了一段时间的现象。

sentences.en: And I'm just interested in sort of digging into that a little bit more, because on one hand, what we might say is too sensitive could also be understood as, you know, the culture
sentences.zh: 而我只是有兴趣更深入地探讨这一点，因为一方面，我们可能认为过于敏感的东西，也可以被理解为，你知道，这种文化

sentences.en: being made safe for people who didn't feel safe in the culture before.
sentences.zh: 正在为那些以前在文化中感到不安全的人创造一个安全的环境。

sentences.en: Like the example that comes to mind for me is, it's one that has to do with your life.
sentences.zh: 比如我脑海中浮现的一个例子，它与你的生活有关。

sentences.en: You have a trans son, right?
sentences.zh: 你有一个跨性别儿子，对吧？

sentences.en: And so the sensitivity around how people talk about transgender people and, you know, what they say and how we think about transgender people, that is directly related to a change
sentences.zh: 因此，围绕人们如何谈论跨性别者、你知道的，他们说的话以及我们如何看待跨性别者的这种敏感度，这与文化的变革直接相关，

sentences.en: in the culture that allows your son to live the life that he wants to live.
sentences.zh: 正是这种变革让你的儿子能够过上他想要的生活。

sentences.en: These things are connected.
sentences.zh: 这些事情是息息相关的。

sentences.en: So how do you see that connection?
sentences.zh: 那么你是如何看待这种联系的？

sentences.en: Like on the one hand, what you're calling the sensitivity, on the other hand, how a culture actually changes?
sentences.zh: 一方面是你所说的敏感，另一方面，文化又是如何真正发生改变的呢？

sentences.en: I'm working on a beautiful hour about that, about the transition.
sentences.zh: 我正在创作一个关于这方面的精彩专场，关于转变。

sentences.en: And as a parent that went through it, I think I have something to say that forwards the agenda of that kind of unconditional love and acceptance for your child and for others.
sentences.zh: 作为经历过这一切的父母，我认为我有些话要说，能推动对孩子以及对他人这种无条件爱与接纳的进程。

sentences.en: I went through it.
sentences.zh: 我经历过。

sentences.en: And the transition wasn't about their transition.
sentences.zh: 而且这种转变并非关于他们的转变。

sentences.en: It was my transition going from like opposing what they wanted to do to complete acceptance.
sentences.zh: 这是我的转变，从反对他们想做的事转变为完全接受。

sentences.en: And it was the five stages of grief.
sentences.zh: 这经历了悲伤的五个阶段。

sentences.en: I felt like I was losing my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我正在失去我的女儿。

sentences.en: My daughter was dying in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我的女儿在我眼前消逝。

sentences.en: And so I speak about this from a true perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以我以真实的角度来谈论这件事。

sentences.en: And I take you through the five stages of grief.
sentences.zh: 我带你经历悲伤的五个阶段。

sentences.en: And midway through the act, after denial, after anger, and when I get to bargaining, that's when the whole set flips.
sentences.zh: 而在表演的中段，经历了否认、愤怒，当我到达妥协阶段时，整个专场就发生了大反转。

sentences.en: Because the people that are angry and in denial, you know, they're all on my side as the parent at firSt.
sentences.zh: 因为那些愤怒和处于否认中的人，你知道，起初他们作为父母都站在我这边。

sentences.en: And I'm talking in complete ignorance because that's what a lot of people are.
sentences.zh: 而我说话时完全出于无知，因为许多人就是那样。

sentences.en: And then the whole set takes a complete 180 because it's about me getting to acceptance.
sentences.zh: 然后整个表演来了个180度大转弯，因为这关乎我如何走向接受。

sentences.en: And I'm, I become a cautionary tale for the people that may be going through this of how you can get through this.
sentences.zh: 我，我成了那些可能正在经历此事的人的警示故事，告诉你如何挺过难关。

sentences.en: Try to get to acceptance as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽量快地去接受现实。

sentences.en: It took me all of a week.
sentences.zh: 我总共只花了一个星期。

sentences.en: That's all.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: It sounds like a busy week.
sentences.zh: 听起来是个忙碌的一周。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Well, I was like, no, you can't do this.
sentences.zh: 当时我的反应是，不，你不能这么做。

sentences.en: You can't do that.
sentences.zh: 你不能那样做。

sentences.en: I'm not supporting it.
sentences.zh: 我绝不支持。

sentences.en: I was, I was that guy.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是、就是那种人。

sentences.en: That was that guy.
sentences.zh: 我曾经就是那种人。

sentences.en: And I'm ashamed to say it because in my eyes, I was protecting my child.
sentences.zh: 我很羞于承认这一点，因为在我的眼里，我是在保护我的孩子。

sentences.en: Now understanding that all I was doing was creating distance and that's not fair to them.
sentences.zh: 现在我明白了，我当时所做的只是在制造距离，这对他们很不公平。

sentences.en: Who the F am I to stand in this person's way and tell them what's right for their life?
sentences.zh: 我算老几，竟敢阻挠这个人，还对他们的人生指手画脚？

sentences.en: I'm a parent.
sentences.zh: 我只是个家长。

sentences.en: And the only thing I can do as a parent is be an example to love my child and hope that other parents do the same.
sentences.zh: 作为一个家长，我唯一能做的就是树立一个榜样，去爱我的孩子，并希望其他父母也能这样做。

sentences.en: So did, did your experience with your son and understanding what your thought process was, the five stages, you know, and how you reacted to, what pronouns does your son use?
sentences.zh: 那么，你和你儿子的经历，以及对你心路历程的理解——那五个阶段，你知道的，以及你当时的反应——你儿子使用的是什么代词？

sentences.en: He and they.
sentences.zh: 他（He）和他们（They）。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, so reacting to what they were going through.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于他们所经历的事情，你是如何做出反应的？

sentences.en: Did that change or affect your thinking at all about comedy and who gets made fun of when and how and when to push buttons?
sentences.zh: 这有没有改变或影响你对喜剧的看法？比如谁在什么时候、以什么方式被取笑，以及何时该触碰底线？

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 算是，也算不是。

sentences.en: I think a comedian has the right to do, have their point of view, just as people have their right to have their point of view.
sentences.zh: 我认为喜剧演员有权表达自己的观点，正如人们有权表达自己的观点一样。

sentences.en: I don't get offended by anybody's humor.
sentences.zh: 我对任何人的幽默都不会感到被冒犯。

sentences.en: I think, look, Don Rickles did a lot of racist jokes, but man, he was really funny.
sentences.zh: 你看，唐·里尔斯开了许多种族主义的玩笑，但天哪，他真的很好笑。

sentences.en: That was a really funny raciSt.
sentences.zh: 那是个非常搞笑的种族主义者。

sentences.en: I'm part comedian, right?
sentences.zh: 我首先是个喜剧演员，对吧？

sentences.en: So before I'm even like black or a man, I'm a comedian.
sentences.zh: 所以在我是个黑人或男人之前，我首先是个喜剧演员。

sentences.en: I, I'm all for comedians developing their point of view, no matter how ignorant, small,
sentences.zh: 我，我全力支持喜剧演员发展他们的观点，无论这些观点多么无知、狭隘、

sentences.en: inconsiderate, dark, they have to do this.
sentences.zh: 欠考虑、黑暗，他们都必须这样做。

sentences.en: Because if nobody tries to find the funny, then society's missing out on humor.
sentences.zh: 因为如果没有人尝试去寻找笑点，那么社会就会错失幽默。

sentences.en: There are certain comedians, I'm thinking of, you know, Ricky Gervais, Dave Chappelle, where
sentences.zh: 有些喜剧演员，我想到了，你知道的，瑞奇·热维斯、戴夫·查佩尔，对他们来说，

sentences.en: it seems like to them, material about transgender people, it's the taboo that they need to keep pushing at to show that they're willing to push at a taboo.
sentences.zh: 关于跨性别者的素材似乎是他们需要不断触碰的禁忌，以此来证明他们愿意挑战禁忌。

sentences.en: I don't think it's the taboo that they're pushing at.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们是在挑战禁忌。

sentences.en: They just want to say what the hell they want to say.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想说他们想说的废话而已。

sentences.en: And who are you to tell me what I can say and not say?
sentences.zh: 你算老几，来告诉我什么能说、什么不能说？

sentences.en: Dave is a friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 戴夫是我的朋友。

sentences.en: I have a trans child.
sentences.zh: 我有一个跨性别孩子。

sentences.en: I'm not going to not be Dave's friend because of his point of view.
sentences.zh: 我不会因为他的观点就不和戴夫做朋友。

sentences.en: I went to see his shows.
sentences.zh: 我去看了他的演出。

sentences.en: We've had several conversations about things.
sentences.zh: 我们曾多次就一些事情进行过交谈。

sentences.en: He knows I have a trans son, but that doesn't change the fact that, hey,
sentences.zh: 他知道我有个跨性别儿子，但这并不改变这样一个事实，那就是，嘿，

sentences.en: you got an hour on this that he wants to do from his point of view and he has every right to do it.
sentences.zh: 他有一整场关于这个的演出，他想从他的角度来做，他完全有权利这么做。

sentences.en: Me and my child had this conversation and they understood, you know, they may feel that way.
sentences.zh: 我和我的孩子谈过这事，他们表示理解，你知道，他们或许会有那种感受。

sentences.en: But I said, as a comedian, he has every right to say what he wants to say and try to find the humor in what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 但我说，作为一名喜剧演员，他完全有权说他想说的话，并试图在他所说的话中寻找幽默。

sentences.en: I don't think his intention is to make you feel bad.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他的本意是让你感觉不好。

sentences.en: I think he's just trying to protect his right to say what he feels.
sentences.zh: 我想他只是在捍卫自己表达真实感受的权利。

sentences.en: We don't have to think alike.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要想法完全一致。

sentences.en: You're still my friend.
sentences.zh: 你依然是我的朋友。

sentences.en: I learned from you.
sentences.zh: 我从你身上学到了东西。

sentences.en: There's things I learned from you.
sentences.zh: 有些东西我是从你这里学到的。

sentences.en: And hopefully through conversations, you know, we could come to the fence and agree on and disagree on some things, but we affect change in each other.
sentences.zh: 希望通过对话，你知道，我们可以坐下来，在某些事情上达成一致或存在分歧，但我们在彼此身上引发了改变。

sentences.en: And that's life.
sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: And I think we have to learn to laugh again.
sentences.zh: 我想我们必须学会重新找回欢笑。

sentences.en: We're heading to a very sad place when we can't laugh anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果我们再也无法欢笑，我们将走向一个非常悲伤的境地。

sentences.en: But, you know, I really think the idea that we don't laugh anymore is just fundamentally wrong.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我真的认为我们不再欢笑这种观点从根本上就是错的。

sentences.en: Like, I think, you know, if you take social media as an example, so it would be just joke after joke after joke, like funny meme after funny meme.
sentences.zh: 比如，我认为，如果你以社交媒体为例，那上面全是一个接一个的笑话，就像一张又一张搞笑的表情包。

sentences.en: To me, the question is really like, what are those jokes saying?
sentences.zh: 对我来说，真正的问题是，这些笑话到底在表达什么？

sentences.en: And are they...
sentences.zh: 它们究竟……

sentences.en: Who's telling the joke?
sentences.zh: 究竟是谁在讲笑话？

sentences.en: Who's telling the joke and what are they trying to convey with the joke?
sentences.zh: 是谁在讲笑话，他们试图通过这个笑话传达什么？

sentences.en: I think that feels to me like the more germane question or the...
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，这似乎才是更切题的问题，或者说……

sentences.en: People don't tell the same jokes they used to at work.
sentences.zh: 人们在工作时不再讲以前那种笑话了。

sentences.en: They don't sit...
sentences.zh: 他们不再坐在一起……

sentences.en: There's no water cooler talk anymore.
sentences.zh: 再也没有饮水机旁的闲聊了。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: It's like...
sentences.zh: 就像是……

sentences.zh: 然后你提到了哈维·韦恩斯坦，你知道的，我……我……我想你认为是他用强硬手段把你挤出了这个系列。

sentences.en: And, and when you brought it up, it was actually, it was Bob and Harvey.
sentences.zh: 而且……而且当你提起这件事时，其实是鲍勃和哈维。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: But it was clear you were loading up a joke and you had this pause where I think you were thinking about then whether to say the joke.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，你当时正准备讲个笑话，你停顿了一下，我想你当时是在考虑接下来要不要讲那个笑话。

sentences.en: And I want to know if you can tell me like in your head, in that moment, when you have the, like the potentially offensive joke lined up, what is actually going through your head
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能告诉我，在脑海里，在那一刻，当你准备好那个可能冒犯人的笑话时，你的脑子里到底在想些什么

sentences.en: in that pause?
sentences.zh: 在那个停顿里？

sentences.en: Who's my audience?
sentences.zh: 我的听众是谁？

sentences.en: And I heard you cringe on the other thing, the monkey joke.
sentences.zh: 我听到你在另一件事——那个猴子的笑话上退缩了。

sentences.en: And I was like, but I was going to say, you know, he, he didn't just, uh, you know, he, he doesn't just rape women.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想说，你知道的，他……他不仅……呃，你知道的，他不仅强暴女性。

sentences.en: He raves too.
sentences.zh: 他也狂热得很。

sentences.en: Trust me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: We did business with him.
sentences.zh: 我们跟他做过生意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So you see your response.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了你的反应。

sentences.en: You see, did you see your response?
sentences.zh: 你看，你看到自己的反应了吗？

sentences.en: I call that, we call that.
sentences.zh: 我把这称为……我们称之为。

sentences.en: And, and like me and my brother, we'd be in a writer's room or we'd be in network notes.
sentences.zh: 而且……就像我和我弟弟，我们会在编剧室里，或者我们会收到电视网的意见反馈。

sentences.en: And, you know, we've always been edgy with our, our humor always.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们的幽默一直以来都很大胆，一直都是如此。

sentences.en: That's just how we do it.
sentences.zh: 我们一向如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so when people have that reaction, like, Oh God, you know, little thing you do, we call that, we used to call that getting on a whitey bike.
sentences.zh: 所以当人们有这种反应时，比如“哦，天哪”，你知道的，你做的那个小动作，我们称之为——我们以前管这叫“骑白人单车”。

sentences.en: It was like brothers would crack up at that, but white people are like, Oh, I don't know about that.
sentences.zh: 这就好比黑人兄弟听到这个会放声大笑，但白人却会觉得，“哦，这我可说不准。”

sentences.en: And they start pedaling backwards.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就开始倒踩车轮。

sentences.en: You know, it's funny though.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不过这挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm not, uh, uh, I don't know if the, the whitey bike is, uh, actually the bike I ride on because I'm not offended, you know, but there is the thing where it's
sentences.zh: 我……我不是……呃……我不知道“白人单车”是不是我真正会骑的那辆单车，因为我并没有被冒犯，你知道的，但确实有这样一种情况，就是

sentences.en: like when somebody says the taboo thing where you go like, Ooh, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 当某人说出禁忌话题时，你会觉得，“哦，我不知道。”

sentences.en: Are you allowed to say that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得能说这个吗？

sentences.en: But that's different than taking offense.
sentences.zh: 但这跟感到被冒犯是两回事。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: But what is taboo when you've been in a situation for me, right?
sentences.zh: 但对于我来说，当你经历过某种处境时，什么才是禁忌呢？对吧？

sentences.en: Once again, I can talk about things from a different perspective.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我可以从不同的角度来谈论事情。

sentences.en: And when I talk about Bob and Harvey and I say that it's because there's damage there.
sentences.zh: 当我谈到鲍勃和哈维并这么说时，是因为其中包含着创伤。

sentences.en: I can go into a whole nother article about the scary movies franchise and you guys are like, Oh, I see why he said what he said, because we have been victims in that way, but
sentences.zh: 我可以深入讲另一篇关于《惊声尖笑》系列电影的文章，然后你们就会觉得，“哦，我明白他为什么会这么说了，因为我们在那方面曾是受害者，但是

sentences.en: in business, not physically, but in business.
sentences.zh: 在生意上，不是身体上，而是在生意上。”

sentences.en: And, you know, I think a monster is a monster and those monsters showed up in business as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我认为恶魔就是恶魔，那些恶魔在生意场上也现形了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, in the good grief special, you talked about, uh, how you learned to be a man from your dad, but I I'm curious about what you learned about manhood and masculinity from
sentences.zh: 你知道，在特辑《节哀顺变》中，你谈到了你是如何从父亲身上学会如何做一个男人的，但我很好奇，你从

sentences.en: your son.
sentences.zh: 你儿子身上学到了关于男子气概和雄性气质的什么？

sentences.en: Um, um, that sometimes you have to work your, your femininity.
sentences.zh: 嗯……嗯，有时候你得发挥你的女性特质。

sentences.en: It's okay to be in touch with your feminine.
sentences.zh: 去触及你柔美的一面是可以的。

sentences.en: It's okay to be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 保持脆弱是可以的。

sentences.en: It's okay to express yourself.
sentences.zh: 表达自己是可以的。

sentences.en: It's okay to unstrap from your masculinity and your ego.
sentences.zh: 卸下你的男子气概和自我防备是可以的。

sentences.en: And sometimes that takes you not to, you know, to have a different approach.
sentences.zh: 有时候，这需要你……你知道的，采取一种不同的方式。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's not about trying to teach them.
sentences.zh: 有时候这并不在于试图去教导他们。

sentences.en: Maybe God's trying to teach you something.
sentences.zh: 也许上帝正试图教导你一些东西。

sentences.en: And so it taught me to be a lot more accepting and unconditional and even forgiving of myself.
sentences.zh: 所以这教会了我变得更加包容、无条件地接纳，甚至学会原谅自己。

sentences.en: It's okay to have stupid thoughts.
sentences.zh: 偶尔有些愚蠢的想法是正常的。

sentences.en: It's okay to forgive yourself for having a point of view.
sentences.zh: 原谅自己持有某种观点是正常的。

sentences.en: That's not completely popular or evolved.
sentences.zh: 那种观点可能并不完全受欢迎，也不是那么成熟。

sentences.en: It's okay to have those small feelings, those insecure things, those egotistical thoughts.
sentences.zh: 偶尔产生那些小心思、不安全感、自我中心的想法是正常的。

sentences.en: That's like, nah, I think I can control everything.
sentences.zh: 就像是在想：“不，我觉得我能掌控一切。”

sentences.en: And then God breaks you down and life breaks you down.
sentences.zh: 然后上帝击碎了你，生活击碎了你。

sentences.en: And when you realize that you are, you're crumbled and you're on your knees, that's when God can
sentences.zh: 当你意识到自己已经支离破碎、双膝跪地时，那就是上帝可以

sentences.en: just whisper to you and you're like, oh, that that's what you're trying to teach me.
sentences.zh: 对你耳语的时刻，你会想：“哦，原来这就是你想要教给我的。”

sentences.en: And I'm very grateful to my child.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激我的孩子。

sentences.en: I love that baby because that's my first born.
sentences.zh: 我爱那个小宝贝，因为那是我的长子。

sentences.en: And I can't say what I am as a father.
sentences.zh: 我无法定义自己作为一个父亲的表现。

sentences.en: They can say what I am as a father.
sentences.zh: 他们才有资格定义我作为一个父亲的表现。

sentences.en: And when I'm gone, I hope I left them with a whole lot of love and a whole lot of memories.
sentences.zh: 等我离去的时候，我希望留给他们的全都是爱，全都是回忆。

sentences.en: Whatever flaws, I wasn't able to show up.
sentences.zh: 无论我有怎样的缺点，没能陪伴在他们身边，

sentences.en: I hope they forgive that.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能原谅这一点。

sentences.en: You've referred a couple of times to hearing God or God talking to you.
sentences.zh: 你曾好几次提到听到上帝的声音或上帝对你说话。

sentences.en: Do you remember the last thing God said to you or the last thing that you remember feeling like it was coming from God?
sentences.zh: 你还记得上帝对你说的最后一句话是什么吗？或者你最后一次感觉是来自上帝的指引是什么时候？

sentences.en: For me, my God speaks to me every day.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我的上帝每天都在对我说靴话。

sentences.en: He's in everything I do, even in my jokes, even in my experience, even in the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他存在于我做的每一件事中，甚至在我的笑话里，甚至在我的经历中，甚至在黑暗之中。

sentences.en: God gave me a gift, which is to stay joyful through dark things.
sentences.zh: 上帝赐予了我一个天赋，那就是在黑暗的境遇中依然保持快乐。

sentences.en: He gave me a gift.
sentences.zh: 他赐予了我这个天赋。

sentences.en: And I'm going to give that gift as much as I can, as long as I can.
sentences.zh: 只要我还行，只要时间允许，我就会尽可能多地把这份天赋带给他人。

sentences.en: And that will be my life identity, is that in the worst moments, I was able to try and find a smile and hold my hand up through the rubble and go, hey, guys,
sentences.zh: 这将是我一生的写照：在最糟糕的时刻，我依然能够努力挤出一抹微笑，从废墟中伸出手去，对大家说，嘿，伙计们，

sentences.en: take this one with
sentences.zh: 把这个也带上

sentences.en: you.
sentences.zh: 吧。

sentences.en: Well, Marlon, you know, geez louise, you got a salty mouth, but I just think you're a you're a heck of a guy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，马龙，天哪，你说话可真够尖酸刻薄的，但我还是觉得你是个绝佳的家伙。

sentences.en: Geez louise is my favorite.
sentences.zh: “天哪”（Geez louise）是我的最爱。

sentences.en: I'm going to keep your number broke anytime I need the white guy voice.
sentences.zh: 只要我需要白人腔调的时候，我随时都会拨通你的电话。

sentences.en: It's been a darn pleasure talking to you.
sentences.zh: 能跟你聊天真是一件令人高兴的事。

sentences.en: Oh, darn tootin' time.
sentences.zh: 哦，真是好极了。
